options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

**Items:** ensure all logically relevant items can be acquired. Some items, such as keys, may be self-locking, and
some locations may be inaccessible.

options.name: Logic Level
options.doc:
The level of logic to use when determining what locations in your world are accessible.

**Normal:** Can require damage boosts, but otherwise approachable for someone who has beaten the game.

**Hard:** Expects more knowledge and tighter execution.
Has leashing, normal clips and much tighter d-boosting in logic.

options.name: Shuffle Portal Outputs
options.doc:
Whether the portals lead to random places.
Entering a portal from its vanilla area will always lead to HQ, and will unlock it if relevant.
Supports plando.

**None:** Portals will take you where they're supposed to.

**Shops:** Portals can lead to any area except Music Box and Elemental Skylands, with each portal output guaranteed
to not overlap with another portal's. Will only put you at a portal or a shop.

**Checkpoints:** Like Shops except checkpoints without shops are also valid drop points.

**Anywhere:** Like Checkpoints except it's possible for multiple portals to output to the same map.
options.doc_html:
Whether the portals lead to random places. Entering a portal from its vanilla area will always lead to HQ, and will unlock it if relevant. Supports plando.

None: Portals will take you where they're supposed to.

Shops: Portals can lead to any area except Music Box and Elemental Skylands, with each portal output guaranteed to not overlap with another portal's. Will only put you at a portal or a shop.

Checkpoints: Like Shops except checkpoints without shops are also valid drop points.

Anywhere: Like Checkpoints except it's possible for multiple portals to output to the same map.
options.doc_fr:
Indique si les portails mènent à des endroits aléatoires.
L'entrée d'un portail depuis sa zone vanille conduira toujours à l'AC, et le déverrouillera le cas échéant.
Soutient la planification.

**None:** Les portails vous emmèneront où ils sont censés.

**Shops:** Les portails peuvent mener à n'importe quelle zone, sauf Music Box et Elemental Skylands, chaque sortie de portail étant garantie de ne pas chevaucher celle d'un autre portail. On ne vous mettra qu'à un portail ou à un magasin.

**Checkpoints:** Comme les magasins sauf les points de contrôle sans magasins sont également des points de chute valides.

**Anywhere:** Comme Checkpoints sauf qu'il est possible pour plusieurs portails de sortir sur la même carte.

options.name: Shuffle Level Transitions
options.doc:
Whether the transitions between the levels should be randomized.
Supports plando.

**None:** Level transitions lead where they should.

**Coupled:** Returning through a transition will take you from whence you came.

**Decoupled:** Any level transition can take you to any other level transition.

options.doc_fr:

**Coupled:** Le retour à travers une transition vous prendra d'où vous êtes venu.

**Decoupled:** Toute transition de niveau peut vous mener à n'importe quelle autre transition de niveau.
